```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: "Pull Request number"
        required: true
        type: string
      comment_id:
        description: "Comment ID (for slash commands)"
        required: false
        type: string
      issue_number:
        description: "Issue number (for slash commands)"
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}" ]]; then
            echo "Error: PR number is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "pr_number=${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install requests PyGithub

      - name: Fetch changed files
        id: fetch_files
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          import os
          import json
          from github import Github

          g = Github(os.environ['GITHUB_TOKEN'])
          repo = g.get_repo("${{ github.repository }}")
          pr = repo.get_pull(int(${{ steps.validate.outputs.pr_number }}))
          
          # Get all changed files
          files = []
          for file in pr.get_files():
              files.append(file.filename)
          
          # Check if any files match connector pattern
          connector_pattern = r'^airbyte-integrations/connectors/[^/]+/'
          connector_files = [f for f in files if re.match(connector_pattern, f)]
          
          print(f"Changed files: {files}")
          print(f"Connector files: {connector_files}")
          
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'w') as f:
              f.write(f"changed_files={json.dumps(files)}\n")
              f.write(f"connector_files={json.dumps(connector_files)}\n")

      - name: Post started comment
        if: steps.fetch_files.outputs.connector_files != '[]'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            🤖 AI Documentation Review Started
            
            Analyzing connector changes for documentation recommendations...
            
            This may take a few minutes.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}

      - name: Skip if no connector changes
        if: steps.fetch_files.outputs.connector_files == '[]'
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: |
            📝 No Connector Changes Detected
            
            This PR doesn't appear to contain changes to any connector directories.
            Skipping AI documentation review.
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number }}

      - name: Trigger Devin AI Documentation Review
        if: steps.fetch_files.outputs.connector_files != '[]'
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@main
        with:
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs_pr_review"
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
          comment-id: ${{ github.event.inputs.comment_id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_AI_TOKEN }}
          start-message: "Starting AI documentation review for connector changes..."
          tags: "documentation,ai-review,connector"
          wait-for-stopped-status: true
          wait-minutes-max: 10
```
